items.text: We're happy to share a new update for Magical Bakery today! Version 1.4.0 for Steam is now live, and we've cooked some important fixes and enhancements. We hope this update makes your time in the bakery smoother, more reliable, and more enjoyable
We hope you enjoy these updates!
🔮Ludovar does not recognize sweets on the tray in the Final Exam
🔮'Waiting Icon' is displayed above the parcel customer's head after delivering the sweet
🔮The player can move the character out of the game world by opening and immediately standing behind the Shop door
🔮The player character passes through the Shop door if standing in opening/closing spot
🔮The "Thrifty" trophy fails to get unlock when player has over 10,000 coins in inventory
🔮The 'Wake Up' animation is displayed even when the character is far away from Baba's bed
🔮Interaction prompts for two interactions are displayed at the same time during the gameplay
🔮Player character appears blurry when running in bedroom
🔮Rotate option fails to respond when using L2/R2 buttons on PS5 or Z/X keys on PC while interacting with Mirror On The Wall
🔮Pause Menu Becomes Unresponsive When Inventory Is Toggled Repeatedly on Top of It
🔮When user is talking to Amber/Arbal/Shen for the second time after main story is finished, title become irresponsive on 'A'/'E" prompt
🔮 Improved how sprinkles get attached to sweets
🔮 Second baking tray can overlap sweet on the floor
🔮 Unable to use Interact option/Button with controller
🔮 Game freezes when a new sweet is obtained while playing with controller
🔮 Elemental action gets confirmed after pressing ESC to cancel on Sprinkling Station
🔮 Player can purchase the ingredients upon clicking anywhere outside the purchase confirmation box
🔮 Unwanted scroll SFX can be heard on all items Index Pages, if the player scrolls through any recipes on the 'Recipes' main page
🔮 D-pad spell indicator does not appear in bedroom area after using spells
🔮 Tables Spotless Spell triggers cooldown when hugging an Elemental in Observatory room at start of day
🔮 Recommendation Slot Board items persist after restarting the day
🔮 Baba’s Special Spell can be reused multiple times in the same day by closing shop and re-entering
🔮 Interaction prompt fails to appear for 'Astral Fruit Plant' pot in Observatory
🔮 Pause Menu Becomes Unresponsive When Inventory Is Toggled Repeatedly on Top of It
🔮 Magical shakers float in the air after interacting with them and move upon using the movement keys/mouse
🔮 Player character appears blurry when running in bedroom
🔮 The "X" button to advance dialogue does not function on the Tutorial Screen when the cursor is enabled
🔮 Unable to place fresh dough in Oven after attempting with spoiled dough during tutorial
🔮 Sprinkles starts moving when the player enters the kitchen
🔮 Transition from Bakery to Observatory causes camera stutter or low frame update
🔮 The achievement 'Sentimentalities' fails to unlock even after meeting the requirements
🔮 The achievement 'Bold Baker' fails to unlock even after reaching Rank 4 as Magical baker
🔮 The achievement 'Satisfied Customers' fails to unlock even after meeting the requirements
As always, thank you for playing and for continuing to share your feedback with us on Steam, it truly helps shape future updates. Happy baking! 🧁

We're so excited to share a tasty new update for Magical Bakery today! Version 1.3.2 for Steam is now live, and we've baked up several important fixes and enhancements so you can keep your bakery running smoothly.
We hope you enjoy these updates! We're brewing up more enhancements to make your experience in Magical Bakery even better, so keep an eye out! Once again, thank you for your continued support!
Limit the number of letters that player is able to use when naming the character.
To implement an option to close the inventory with the back button
Code string is visible during the dialogue with Baba.
VFX - Ice aura looks grey.
Code String appears on some tutorials when them are displayed.
Place holder present in dialogue text when player interacts with Arbal.
Turn pages by pressing D-pad is mentioned in the Grimoire tutorial however LT and RT are displayed in the game.
The game gets stuck on the confirmation prompt after pressing the Options button while transitioning downstairs or upstairs.
"Any Regrets" achievement does not get unlocked even after selling ingredients back to Shen.
Spoiled Sweet Turns into Burned Sweet After Bringing It from Bedroom to Kitchen.
Some words displayed during tutorial text are incorrectly positioned outside their intended layout.
Debug symbols are displayed during the conversations on multiple instances in Simplified and Traditional Chinese languages. --> PENDING TO CONFIRM FIX.
Chalkboard items disappearing when moving to bedroom on same day.
The applied color blindness setting is inconsistent when the user approaches an interactable object in the bedroom.
Player can give spoiled Favorite sweet to NPC characters. --> PENDING TO CONFIRM FIX.
The "Your Trusted Blacksmith" trophy incorrectly unlocks after purchasing all upgrades under the Bakery category.
The "Baba's Comfort" trophy fails to unlock after purchasing all bedroom upgrades from Amber.
Ordered Parcel/Courier disappears after going upstairs and coming back to the kitchen area.
The "Recycling" trophy fails to unlock after acquiring all ingredients from a baked sweet from Bob.
Customer accepts, eats and pays for the burnt sweet.
Ingredients Mixture Disappears When the Player Starts Mixing and Moves to Bed.
Debug symbols are displayed during the conversation with Baba before the introduction of Ludovar.
Water element tutorial triggers again if the player character returns after visiting the bedroom.
Elementals goes to sleep mode if the player character visits the bedroom and returns.
A few letters are already present in the text box after playing the Over tutorial in Japanese language.
Colour changes in bedroom when applying colour blindness option.
Thief Tutorial Bell.
-SUPERLUMEN & SOEDESCO
